## Try this exploration in your product

Snapshot of `2ccfe16` on `explore/button-normal-again`. Install it in a product branch that deploys to staging; production keeps the released version.

This is an exploration: it is never merged as is. Use it for a prototype, a user test, a demo or an A/B idea, then promote it to review or close it.

```sh
npm i @bridge-ds/tokens@https://github.com/peterbono/ai-design-system-demo/releases/download/preview-pr-64/bridge-ds-tokens-2ccfe16.tgz @bridge-ds/core@https://github.com/peterbono/ai-design-system-demo/releases/download/preview-pr-64/bridge-ds-core-2ccfe16.tgz @bridge-ds/react@https://github.com/peterbono/ai-design-system-demo/releases/download/preview-pr-64/bridge-ds-react-2ccfe16.tgz
```
